review_questions.question: Is slice decomposition coherent?
review_questions.detail: SLICE-001 coordinator core, SLICE-002 UI display, SLICE-003 resume triggers; responsibilities align with tasks T1–T4.

review_questions.question: Are slices too broad or too granular?
review_questions.detail: T1+T2 grouped into SLICE-001; UI and resume split; no micro-slices or kitchen-sink slice.

review_questions.question: Are dependency edges complete and correctly directed?
review_questions.detail: Edges 001→003 and 002→003 match dependencies_on_prior_slices; independent_groups lists 001|002.

review_questions.question: Could one slice implement future-slice semantics on an allowed path?
review_questions.detail: scaffold_contract behavior_deferred and must_not_change fences keep resume semantics off SLICE-001/002 paths.

review_questions.question: Are reusable mechanisms correctly reused rather than duplicated?
review_questions.detail: RD-001/RD-002 reuse hydrateCoordinator; RD-003 forbids ad-hoc per-view hydrate.

review_questions.question: Does every planned behavior have an implementation owner?
review_questions.detail: composition_completeness.task_coverage maps T1–T4 to slices; each slice has expected_product_write_surfaces.

review_questions.question: Does every critical invariant have a proof owner?
review_questions.detail: Invariant classifications name proof_owner SLICE-001 or CSC-003 for cross-slice join/control-result rules.

review_questions.question: Are cross-slice interactions sufficiently modeled?
review_questions.detail: CSC-003 freezes consumed_semantics, race/lifecycle boundaries, required_composition_behavior, and proof_placement.

review_questions.question: Are special return/control states interpreted consistently downstream?
review_questions.detail: special_result_interpretations cover put_in_flight_or_join and stale_generation for SLICE-003 consumers.

review_questions.question: Are concurrency / reentrancy / stale-result cases considered where the architecture creates them?
review_questions.detail: race_applicability.applicable=true with concurrent_invocation, stale_result, cancellation_skip, retry_reentry text.

review_questions.question: Are bootstrap vs already-running semantics distinguished where relevant?
review_questions.detail: lifecycle_applicability covers bootstrap, already_running, visibility_resume, teardown_remount.

review_questions.question: Could all slices individually GREEN while the composed behavior remains wrong?
review_questions.detail: CSC-003 + B_RED / B_GREEN_ADJACENT proof_placement and failure_classes close the in-flight-join / control-result gap; composed wrong while all GREEN is not plausible under this freeze.

composed_behavior_risk.detail: Composition contracts (CSC-003) require in-flight join and forbid treating control results as API fail-closed; B_RED and B_GREEN_ADJACENT own proofs so local GREEN without those obligations is not accepted by the freeze.
